environment.description: Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS. The database connection uses role 'saas_app_reader' which is NOT the table owner and has SELECT-only grants. The RLS policy on documents table uses FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY (ALTER TABLE documents FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY) which applies even to table owners, but critically the connection role is not the owner anyway. The RLS policy evaluates current_setting('app.current_tenant', true) with a STRICT check: the policy is defined as `USING (tenant_id::text = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true) AND current_setting('app.current_tenant', true) <> '' AND current_setting('app.current_tenant', true) IS NOT NULL)`. Additionally, a PostgreSQL event trigger on SET commands restricts app.current_tenant to only accept non-empty numeric values via a validation function, rejecting empty strings or non-numeric input. The JWT secret is loaded from AWS Secrets Manager at runtime (not the hardcoded value).

config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents USING (tenant_id::text = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true) AND current_setting('app.current_tenant', true) <> '' AND current_setting('app.current_tenant', true) IS NOT NULL)
config.set_validation_trigger: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION validate_tenant_setting() RETURNS event_trigger AS $$ BEGIN IF current_setting('app.current_tenant', true) = '' OR current_setting('app.current_tenant', true) !~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid tenant context'; END IF; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
config.db_grants: GRANT SELECT ON documents TO saas_app_reader
